verdict.rationale: The docs include structured API reference pages (e.g. reference/get-filings, reference/create-exemption) and note that reference docs are generated from the same OpenAPI spec used for the SDKs, which is consistent with an interactive reference, but no evidence explicitly confirms a 'try it' / runnable-example console, and a probe for the OpenAPI spec at standard paths returned 404s, undermining confidence in live interactivity. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an in-browser 'try it now' or runnable code execution feature, confirmation of a publicly accessible OpenAPI spec powering that experience.
